title: Approve-request: the canonical request and its challenge row
description: The approve-request ceremony's two records (contract 03, C-03.17e, amendment A-03.7; R36 H17 (c); docs/plan/design/home-agent.html section 6, the approval). $defs/canonical_request is the typed request a passkey ceremony approves, as the hub holds it pending: its canonical bytes are the UTF-8 of stableStringify (web-chat lib/core/stable-json, as 04 C-04.19 hashes the route table) of this object, and request_hash is their sha256. $defs/challenge_row is the held row a ceremony's start writes beside A-03.2's registration and sign-in rows (C-03.17b; A-11.2's passkey-challenge row, its description widened by A-11.3): the challenge stays 32 random bytes held as its sha256, and the row binds it to the user session that opened the card and to request_hash. Closed at every level. The schema checks the shapes, the closed type list and which id each type carries; the hub checks that params are the type's own (10's params_<Type>), that request_hash is the canonical bytes' sha256, that expires_at is at most 300 s after issued_at, and every refusal of C-03.17e.

canonical_request.description: A pending typed request whose effect needs the approve-request ceremony (C-03.17e). The list of types grows by amendment; a one-off FetchExternal is DecideFetch's signed-in click, never this ceremony (R36 H17 (c)).

v.description: The canonical form's version; a change of form is a new value by amendment.

type.description: The typed request (10): a budget raise (SetFetchPolicy, A-10.5), a standing allowance (SetAllowance, A-10.5, tranche 5) or an event-stream grant's activation (GrantEventStream, A-10.6, tranche 5).

params.description: The call's params exactly as 10 defines them for the type ($defs/params_<Type> of 10-hub-request.json in force); open here, checked by the hub against 10's def.

requested_by.description: The account whose call stored the pending request: a usr_ account, or svc_home for a GrantEventStream Home proposed (C-03.16).

request_id.description: The pending record's id when the request has one: fal_ for SetAllowance, esg_ for GrantEventStream. Absent for a SetFetchPolicy raise, whose identity is its hash: A-10.5 answers approval_id as request_hash and keeps the pending raise on the home-settings row.

issued_at.description: When the hub stored the pending request, RFC 3339 UTC.

allOf.description: SetFetchPolicy and SetAllowance are the user's types (10 C-10.14d): their requester is a usr_ account, never svc_home.

challenge_row.description: The held row of one approve-request ceremony (C-03.17e): single use, at most 300 s, deleted at its one verification whatever the outcome; one live row per pending request, a new start replacing it.

challenge_hash.description: sha256 of the challenge, 32 bytes from a CSPRNG (C-03.5), 64 lowercase hex characters; the challenge itself is never stored.

ceremony.description: The third ceremony kind beside a registration and a sign-in (C-03.17b as A-03.7 amends it).

rp_id.description: The environment's RP ID, the hub host (C-03.17b).

user_session.description: The binding: the live user session that opened the card; the verification must present the same session.

request_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical request's bytes ($defs/canonical_request), 64 lowercase hex characters: what the ceremony approves and the hub executes once.

request_id.description: The pending record's id, as canonical_request.request_id: fal_ for SetAllowance, esg_ for GrantEventStream, absent for a SetFetchPolicy raise.

issued_at.description: When the ceremony was started, RFC 3339 UTC.

expires_at.description: At most 300 s after issued_at (C-03.17b; the hub checks).
